amendment_lineage.amendment_scope: Operational completeness, chronology correction, exact truth verification, lazy p100 access, computed slice integrity, and crash-safe execution only.

trigger_resolution.required_state: independent QA PASS plus separately sealed external authorization

cycle_relation.cycle_2_eligible_only_after: This cycle reaches terminal RESEARCH_GO on exact same-season and locked p100 with every integrity and slice gate passing.
cycle_2_prohibited_after: integrity, chronology, truth, or leakage failure

hypothesis: A whole-trajectory match of public-layer temperature and salinity can identify historical vertical-curvature regimes that pointwise analogs miss. Transferring only the historical target-layer residual from contemporaneous public-depth interpolation, rather than absolute target temperature, can achieve transport-sized improvement while failing closed to the frozen anchor when trajectory support is weak.

historical_observations.access: Only inside a separately authorized worker through a held-byte handle.

exact_anchor.access: Hash and parse only inside a separately authorized worker before exact scoring.

locked_p100_anchor.access: DEFERRED: neither hash nor parse until exact RESEARCH_GO is durably recorded.

data_features_target_firewall.training_target: Historical truth temperature minus contemporaneous piecewise-linear public-depth temperature interpolation.
data_features_target_firewall.source_prefix_only_scaling: Robust median and IQR are computed only from each eligible historical source prefix; query rows never update scaling.
data_features_target_firewall.joint_pseudo_gap_mask: Temperature and salinity for target layers 2, 3, and 4 are jointly hidden before any feature, scaling, prefilter, trajectory, or residual construction.

operational_numeric_amendment.comparison_grid_aggregation: For each UTC-ns hour [h,h+60m), take the channel median of finite raw 10-minute values; missingness is one minus finite/raw expected count; label at h. No interpolation across hours.
operational_numeric_amendment.query_unit: One KST calendar day at a time. For query day D, query_start is D 00:00 KST and the public trajectory is [query_start-context_days, query_start). The transferred daily residual template is applied only to target timestamps in [D 00:00,D+1 00:00).
operational_numeric_amendment.source_end_grid: KST midnight daily grid, exclusive source endpoint. A source trajectory is [source_end-context_days,source_end).
operational_numeric_amendment.prefilter: Compute source-prefix-robust-scaled per-channel median, IQR, first-last slope, coverage, and missingness summaries; rank squared Euclidean distance; ties by source_end UTC-ns; run constrained DTW only on first 16.
operational_numeric_amendment.operational_rationale: An hourly trajectory retains the registered 1/3/7-day shape and 6h/24h dynamics while bounding the 12-hour DTW corridor. Sixteen prefilter candidates are at least twice k=7, preventing the prefilter from defining support too narrowly. Daily source ends avoid an unregistered dense endpoint search and make chronology auditable.
operational_numeric_amendment.timezone_and_integer_time: Parse timezone-aware values, convert to UTC, explicitly convert to datetime64[ns], use DatetimeIndex.as_unit('ns').asi8, and reconstruct only with pd.to_datetime(value,unit='ns',utc=True).

source_embargo.required_formula: source_end <= query_start - 7 days for every considered and selected source trajectory

trajectory_algorithm.residual_aggregation: weighted median at each aligned target-layer timestamp
trajectory_algorithm.weak_support_policy: Return the exact anchor prediction bit-for-bit with correction zero.
trajectory_algorithm.endpoint_missing_policy: If public L1 or L5 is missing or nonfinite at a target timestamp, return the exact anchor prediction bit-for-bit with correction zero for that target timestamp.
trajectory_algorithm.projection: Append fixed finite public endpoints L1 and L5 to candidate L2-L4 and project the five values onto the endpoint-determined monotone direction while keeping endpoints fixed; equal endpoints project to the constant endpoint.

inner_joint_target_mask_windows.effective_candidate_rule: For each query day, source_end <= query_start - 7 days.
For each query day, source_end <= query_start - 7 days.
For each query day, source_end <= query_start - 7 days.

leakage_safe_splits.selection_rule: Select one of six cells using only joint temperature/salinity pseudo-gaps in 2024 March, May, and July; exact and p100 labels never select a cell.

fixed_search_and_budget.selection: Minimize equal-weight mean inner-window, equal-weight layer RMSE; ties by lower worst-window RMSE, shorter context, fewer neighbors.

truth_and_key_verification.procedure: Independently build sorted (UTC-ns time,layer,truth) keys from held historical observations for 2024-09-01 through 2024-10-31 KST and layers 2-4; verify anchor keys and anchor truth against this frame before candidate scoring; then verify candidate keys against the independently verified frame.

evaluation.comparator: Frozen exact incumbent selected by the independently approved trigger resolution.
evaluation.primary_metric: row-pooled RMSE in raw degrees Celsius
evaluation.primary_delta: candidate minus anchor; negative is improvement

locked_p100_slice_contract.lazy_access: P100 path is not opened, stat-hashed, byte-hashed, or parsed until the exact RESEARCH_GO event is durably journaled.
locked_p100_slice_contract.binning: Decile edges are computed from finite supported rows on the entire locked p100 surface using deterministic linear quantiles; repeated edges collapse deterministically and are reported. No bin or threshold is selected from performance.
locked_p100_slice_contract.integrity: For every partitioning slice family, row counts plus explicit nonfinite/unsupported buckets equal 78156; all metric values on nonempty finite buckets are derived from row-level verified keys and truth; fold and layer gate values are computed from those aggregates.
locked_p100_slice_contract.required_slices_logged_gate: True only when the slice validator derives complete inventories, population identities, finite metrics, and digest lineage; it may never be assigned as a literal constant.

exact_once_and_failure_contract.single_permanent_claim: create-only file, fully flushed, file-fsynced, then parent directory fsynced before work
exact_once_and_failure_contract.journal: append-only NDJSON; each record flushed and file-fsynced; parent directory fsynced after creation
exact_once_and_failure_contract.atomic_result_build: write unique create-only temporary file in staging, flush and fsync it, atomically replace a staging name, then fsync the staging directory
exact_once_and_failure_contract.publication: create-only hardlinks into a new final directory; verify byte identity; publish exactly one terminal marker last; fsync each file and final directory
exact_once_and_failure_contract.terminal_exclusivity: Exactly one terminal state across durable journal terminal, validated OOB terminal, and final terminal marker. Any conflict fails closed without overwriting either record.
exact_once_and_failure_contract.oob: Create-only OOB receipt with experiment/attempt/design/authorization identity, complete observed inventory with bytes and hashes, sanitized error provenance, file fsync and directory fsync; re-read and verify identity plus inventory.
exact_once_and_failure_contract.error_provenance: Sanitized exception type, defining module, message SHA-256, traceback SHA-256, and frame module/function names; no local variables, raw data, or secrets.
exact_once_and_failure_contract.windows_process_tree: Enumerate root and all descendants before termination; terminate the full tree; enumerate again and verify root plus every captured descendant absent; store only PID inventory and aggregate proof.

P3_deprioritization.reason: P3 headroom alone cannot produce the requested 2-3 points; preserve its separate frozen experiment and prioritize P2.

limitations: The exact surface is one 2024 September-October regime.
DTW can match coincidental public-layer shapes without target-layer hysteresis.
Hourly aggregation can discard sub-hour structure.
Daily source endpoints can miss useful intraday analogs but are frozen to prevent implicit search.
The monotone endpoint projection can oversmooth inversions.
The locked p100 surface is a local proxy, not an official-score oracle.
Passing gates does not authorize candidate generation or upload.
